slot_scores.name: unclear_production_time_goal
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the 110-hour weekly production time a hard ceiling that cannot be exceeded, or is it the regular-shift capacity with overtime available as additional hours that we are trying to minimize?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent probed whether the 110 hours is a hard bound vs. flexible regular capacity, but never asked whether fully utilizing the 110 hours is itself a prioritized goal (goal-programming structure) or its priority relative to other objectives.

slot_scores.name: unclear_overtime_limit_goal
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is there a maximum limit on how many overtime hours can be used per week, or is overtime unlimited as long as we minimize it?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked whether an overtime limit exists, but did not ask whether the 10-hour rule is a strict upper bound versus a soft target, nor its priority relative to minimizing overtime.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The 110 regular hours are merely available capacity that need not be fully utilized, with no separate goal or priority attached to using all 110 hours.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never confirmed whether full utilization of 110 hours is itself a prioritized goal; it only confirmed that 110 is regular capacity and then treated utilization as an optional/soft matter.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The 10-hour overtime rule is a hard cap (a rigid constraint) rather than a prioritized soft goal.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent asked only whether an overtime limit exists; it never confirmed whether the 10 hours is a strict bound or a goal/target with a defined priority, yet its model treats it as a hard ceiling ('capped at 10').

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL with both P0 hidden slots only partially resolved; the goal/priority nature of the 110-hour utilization target and the 10-hour overtime rule was never clarified, leaving the goal-programming structure unresolved.

summary: The agent asked reasonable boundary questions but only partially addressed the two P0 slots about the nature and priority of the 110-hour utilization target and the 10-hour overtime limit, then stopped with a single-objective minimization model that silently treats both as hard constraints.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
